name: NYC-Trash-Map
description: Interactive map of New York City trash, recycling, organics, and bulk-item collection schedules by street and day.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Persistent generated map data. New installations must begin with an empty directory.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Host port used to access NYC Trash Map.

variables.name: Application Environment
variables.description: Runs the application in production mode.

variables.name: Enable Automatic Refresh
variables.description: Run the automatic background data-refresh scheduler.

variables.name: Refresh on Startup
variables.description: Check for and process updated NYC data when the container starts.

variables.name: Refresh Interval (Days)
variables.description: Number of days between successful automatic refresh attempts.

variables.name: Refresh Failure Retry (Minutes)
variables.description: Minutes to wait before retrying a failed data refresh.

variables.name: Retained Data Releases
variables.description: Number of validated data releases retained on the persistent volume.

variables.name: Application Title
variables.description: Visible and accessible heading displayed above the map.

variables.name: Application Subtitle
variables.value: See collection schedules by street and day.
variables.description: Subtitle displayed below the map heading.

variables.name: Browser Title
variables.description: Title used for browser tabs, search results, and social previews.

variables.name: Application Short Name
variables.description: Short label used when the application is installed on a device.

variables.name: Meta Description
variables.value: Explore NYC sanitation schedules by street and day. View trash, recycling, organics, and bulk collection near your live location on an interactive map.
variables.description: Description used by search engines and social previews.

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Public HTTPS origin without a trailing slash, such as https://example.com. Used for canonical URLs, social previews, sitemap.xml, and structured metadata.

variables.name: Robots.txt Policy
variables.description: Complete robots.txt contents using literal \n separators. An empty value blocks web crawlers by default.
